item.title: Show HN: Sounds – Infinite funk fusion rhodes licks (or any other loop you want)
item.summary: Hi HN! I could never find the right sample for my music, so we built Sounds. A collaborative catalog of free samples and loops, generated with our music model. Everything is free to browse and download, but the most fun part is to generate your own. Every generation joins the public library, so the catalog grows from what people couldn't find.
